title: Serverless ML Pipelines with Cost-Aware Model Partitioning in Cloud–Edge Environments
content: Deploying machine learning (ML) inference pipelines in production increasingly demands both low latency and cost efficiency—two objectives that are difficult to satisfy simultaneously in either a pure-cloud or pure-edge serverless setting. This paper presents CostSplit, a cost-aware model partitioning framework for serverless ML pipelines across cloud–edge environments. CostSplit profiles each layer of a deep neural network (DNN) to determine an optimal split point, executing early layers on edge nodes via OpenFaaS and later layers on AWS Lambda, guided by a joint optimization objective that minimizes the weighted sum of end-to-end inference latency and invocation cost. We further incorporate a lightweight keep-warm strategy to mitigate cloud cold-start overheads. Experiments on ResNet-50 and MobileNetV2 using the ImageNet validation set show that CostSplit achieves latency reductions of 50–60% over cloud-only deployment and reduces per-1,000-invocation cost by up to 65% at high bandwidth and request rates.
